acceptance_gate.principle: Product value is conditional, additive coverage measured with a paired significance test -- a higher AUROC alone is not the second-pair-of-eyes claim.

field_principles.code_conditional_catch_rate_ensemble_ove: Errors the ensemble catches that confidence misses -- the second-pair-of-eyes signal for code.
field_principles.factual_conditional_catch_rate_ensemble_: Same for facts -- the core-motivation product signal.
field_principles.fused_detector_auroc: ensemble OR confidence -- the deployable detector's headline number.
field_principles.fusion_beats_confidence_alone: True iff the fused detector materially beats confidence -- the real 'is the verifier worth adding' answer.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Scores cached corpora through the corrected Exp 3642 substrate; no live LLM load.
field_principles.mcnemar_p_code: Paired significance of the ensemble-vs-confidence disagreement (not just a point estimate).
field_principles.n_errors_per_domain: Sample-size rigor for the conditional-catch claim.
field_principles.second_pair_of_eyes_real: True iff the ensemble catches a significant set confidence misses in >=1 domain with McNemar p<0.05 -- re-derived honestly vs the contaminated prior claim.

fused_detector_method: max_negative-tail-calibrated ensemble/confidence score, equivalent to an OR over detector alert budgets.
inference_substrate: verifier_ensemble_against_cached_candidates (principle: scores cached corpora; no LLM load).
